notes: Only es_value_o and pval_value_o were assigned; all other fields are unassigned placeholders. Study 5 and page locator identify the experiment, but the broad description does not distinguish the ISI main effect, number-of-tones main effect, or N-by-ISI interaction. There is no direct vision-versus-audition test in this experiment. Selecting a test would require an unsupported correspondence assumption. Candidates, kept paired by test: ISI main effect F(3, 9) = 8.5, p = .005, printed eta-squared = .74; N main effect F(3, 9) < 1, with no numeric p or eta-squared given; interaction F(9, 27) = 2.6, p = .03, printed eta-squared = .46. The PDF prints eta-squared (no partial subscript); canonical OCR renders eta as Z and equals signs as 5. No metric conversion or N derivation performed.
